property_summary: Anyone can change betLimit via AdjustBetAmounts, whereas in the reference only the owner can.

Only the original owner (address(this)) can change betLimit via AdjustBetAmounts; the mutant allows any caller to change it, so after a non-owner calls AdjustBetAmounts with a non-zero amount, betLimit will differ from the reference where the call would revert.
The betLimit can only be changed by the owner in the reference, but the mutant allows anyone to change it, violating access control.
For any caller who is not the original owner, a call to AdjustBetAmounts(x) must leave betLimit unchanged; in the reference only the owner can change it, but the mutant allows anyone to change it.
In the reference, a non-owner calling AdjustBetAmounts must revert and leave betLimit unchanged; in the mutant it succeeds and changes betLimit.
